finalText:
Build's clean now — exit 0, 0 errors. There were two real bugs under all the deprecation noise, both in `src/`, caused by the bundler bump changing shapes it hands to your code:

- **`src/core/options.js`** — the new bundler passes options as `{ retryCount }`, but this code still read `options.retries` (undefined), so `.toFixed(0)` threw. Fixed to read `retryCount`.
- **`src/net/retryPolicy.js`** — the new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, and this strict boolean check threw on anything but `true`/`false`. Added an `undefined` → `false` (disabled) case.

The rest of the ~950 lines (DEP0142/0198/0233/0250/0267, tree-shaking notes, dedupe passes) is just deprecation/informational noise from the bump and isn't blocking anything — worth cleaning up eventually (e.g. swapping `fs.exists`/`Buffer()`/`punycode` usages) but not build-breaking.
